Mesa 3D (devkitPro's switch-mesa package: libEGL, libglapi and the nouveau
OpenGL driver), linked statically into tssm.nro.

Mesa's core library and drivers are under the MIT licence below; a few other
parts are under other permissive licences. Mesa's own licence page lists them:
https://docs.mesa3d.org/license.html. The copyright notices are in the source
files themselves: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa; devkitPro's
package recipe (source and patches) is under switch/mesa in
https://github.com/devkitPro/pacman-packages.
